description: CDW CIS L1 baseline SharePoint Online and OneDrive tenant-level settings, applied through Microsoft Graph (admin/sharepoint/settings). External sharing limited to new and existing guests (no Anyone links), guests must sign in with the invited account and can't reshare, legacy auth off, idle session sign-out, comments and newsfeed off. Covers parts of CIS 7.2.1, 7.2.3, 7.2.6, 7.3.2. Default link type, link expiry and guest expiry aren't in Graph and need SharePoint PowerShell (runner).
